implementation_contract.question: Can the correct direct Q plus direct E5M2 K/V cache epilogue improve the exact qualified c32 endpoint when integrated through the installed Gemma4Attention producer and stock Triton consumers?
required_behavior: Install the measured direct epilogue through the pinned Gemma4Attention source path without changing checkpoint, launch flags, workload, scheduler, cache dtype, page size, attention backends, or stock sampling.

Use the real forward-batch request-to-token/cache mapping; preserve padding, dynamic request reuse, sequence positions, CUDA-graph rows, local-window ownership, global layers, and KV-shared-layer semantics.
Apply the candidate only where its exact source and cache ownership are proven. Preserve the stock path for excluded or shared-KV cases rather than manufacturing a component-wide gain.

Provide a project-relative detached endpoint owner that atomically claims only after a later director execution binding, launches a fresh candidate server, runs exactly one hash-bound c32 workload, persists raw responses, path proof, request accounting, timing, GPU telemetry, terminal, and generation-fenced release evidence.

Keep launcher and ordinary runtime adapters mutable after recoverable pre-science failures; keep the model, workload, scientific candidate, consumer semantics, and single endpoint submission immutable.
readiness_requirements: Hash every required project file and every immutable input above.
Name the exact project-relative owner start command and its bounded repair/terminal/release behavior.
Show a source-level causal diff from the measured component to the installed runtime path, including the first stock attention consumer and cache ownership.
Compile and run narrow CPU/static checks only; do not claim a GPU or rehearse the full endpoint.
Set endpoint_science_consumed false and endpoint_submission_count zero.

lifecycle.next_lifecycle_decision: A later director may publish one execution binding only after ENDPOINT_READY.json is complete and leaves measured load, endpoint, terminal, and release margin. If readiness is absent or cannot fit, drain and clean the bench before r10.
